title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Organizing or Transporting Another Person to Illegally Cross the National Border (Frontier) and Other Such Crimes

articles.content_en: Article 1 Any conduct of leading, plotting, or commanding others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), or carrying out acts such as soliciting, enticing, or introducing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier) under the command of a principal offender, shall constitute the crime of "organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier)" as provided in Article 318 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 2 The term "a large number of persons" as prescribed in subparagraph (2) of Article 318 and subparagraph (1) of Article 321 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China shall generally refer to cases where the number of persons organized or transported to illegally cross the national border (frontier) is ten or more.

Article 3 Where five or more exit certificates are used or fraudulently obtained for the purpose of organizing others to illegally cross the national border (frontier), or illegal fees of 300,000 yuan or more are collected for handling certificates, such conduct shall constitute the "serious circumstances" of the crime of fraudulently obtaining exit certificates as provided in paragraph 1 of Article 319 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.
